close_reason: Fixed in 6990371 on PR #7: HTML :key expressions execute in generator scope. Regression covers key-only bindings with and without :if; 506 tests and all CI jobs pass.
description:
Reproducer (in octo_pi_tui2): apps/octo_pi_tui2/lib/octo_pi/tui2/defaults/transcript.ex:42
Compiler emits: warning: variable "idx" is unused (if the variable is not meant to be used, prefix it with an underscore) But idx IS used — by the sibling :key={idx} attribute on the same element. The :for codegen and the :key codegen appear to be analysed in separate scopes, so the :key reference doesn't satisfy the :for binding's usage check. Workaround in calling code: prefix as _idx (but :key still references 'idx', which then becomes a real unused-var). Currently dodgeable only by leaving the warning, which conflicts with the host project's 'warnings are errors' policy. Expected: a :for-bound variable referenced inside a sibling special attr (:key, :if) on the same element should count as 'used'.
title: :for binding shows as unused when only consumed by sibling :key
